verification_summary.balance_notes: Source-access disparity, not candidate disparity: the large-print/full pamphlet PDFs are only readable through Broussard and the start of Greene's statements, and the individual statement PDFs for Broussard, Greene, Williams, Ong Norris and Zaghloul are scans with no machine-readable text. Cruz and Robertson have readable individual statements, so they have T1 positions; Williams, Ong Norris and Zaghloul have only T3 (Portland Mercury 2026-09-26) items, and Broussard and Greene mix T1 bio with few positions. Verifier hit the same limits (PDF text truncated at Greene's statement). Same search effort appears applied to all seven; disparity is documented in each file's gaps. File-level: Surname in statements corrected to 'Ong Norris'.
